old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a modern glass building against a backdrop of a clear blue sky with scattered white clouds. The building's facade is composed of large, reflective glass panels framed by dark metal beams, creating a grid-like pattern. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing on the architectural details of the building. As the video progresses, the clouds move across the sky, their shapes and positions changing subtly over time. The reflections on the glass panels shift accordingly, mirroring the movement of the clouds and the changing light conditions. The overall scene conveys a sense of tranquility and the interplay between man-made structures and natural elements.

caption: The video captures a low-angle, fixed view of the corner of a modern glass-clad building, where a vertical stone column rises toward a dark recessed notch and a grid of dark mullions frames a mirrored facade. The structure and mullion lines hold their exact positions throughout, so the only motion comes from the reflected sky. A bright cumulus cloud mass drifts slowly leftward across the right-hand facade, rising slightly as it travels, while a smaller wispy reflection enters at the upper-right edge and slides the same way. The angled corner panels shift in step, with cloud shapes sliding into and out of the narrower left-side panes. The deep blue sky tone and the dark notch stay constant as the reflected clouds continue their steady passage.
